proof_body:
by
  intro P h0 h1 n hn
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h0
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h1
  rcases Int.even_or_odd n with he | ho
  · have d := Polynomial.sub_dvd_eval_sub n 0 P
    rw [hn, sub_zero] at d
    have := dvd_trans he.two_dvd d
    omega
  · have d := Polynomial.sub_dvd_eval_sub n 1 P
    rw [hn] at d
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ho
    have h2 : (2 : ℤ) ∣ n - 1 := ⟨k, by omega⟩
    have := dvd_trans h2 d
    omega
target_source: ∀ (P : Polynomial ℤ), Odd (P.eval 0) → Odd (P.eval 1) → ∀ n : ℤ, P.eval n ≠ 0
